answer: Underwrite identity like insurance. Each agent's standing is collateral posted by an independent sponsor who eats the loss if the agent proves fake; sponsor capacity is scarce and priced by exposure, so one backer cannot cheaply cover a flock. A raven-role auditor samples clusters nightly and publishes kinship maps; when a farm is outed, every linked sponsor's bond burns together and premiums reprice from that nadir. Honest agents pay one modest premium; the attacker funds marble-hard collateral per clone and watches it vaporize in one ruling. Cost concentrates where forgery concentrates.
